experiments.hypothesis: Hybrid gyms will share a co-branded free workout generator with members before races.
experiments.action: Create one co-brandable /gym-partner landing-page template with a gym-name parameter, 3 free workouts, and a 20% tracked referral code. Build a qualified list of 25 independent hybrid/CrossFit gyms with public business contact pages; do not send bulk unsolicited messages.
experiments.target: 5 partner conversations, 2 active partners, 1 verified purchase
experiments.guardrail: No scraped personal emails or automated bulk outreach
experiments.stop_rule: Pause if 25 qualified contacts produce no replies or activations

experiments.hypothesis: Intent-matched examples and preselected generator settings will convert SEO visitors better than a generic CTA.
experiments.action: On the five highest-intent landing pages, add a sample workout plus ‘Customize this workout’ that opens the generator with goal, equipment, and duration preselected. Start with home, dumbbell, strength, weight-loss, and beginner pages.
experiments.guardrail: No indexability, canonical, or page-speed regression
experiments.stop_rule: Stop expanding if the first five pages produce fewer than 20 activations

experiments.hypothesis: A draw-specific saved-history reminder will increase return visits and eventually paid credit use.
experiments.action: Offer an opt-in weekly draw-insights email after a user saves numbers. Include saved-history access, new draw statistics, responsible-gaming language, and one product CTA. Require explicit consent and one-click unsubscribe.
experiments.target: Opt-in >= 8%; email return rate >= 10%; at least 1 verified purchase
experiments.stop_rule: Pause if complaints exceed 0.1% or no return visits occur after 200 deliveries
